east_texas.title: What a wet East Texas winter does to cheap lights
text: Our winters are humid, and they swing. Seventy degrees on a Tuesday and twenty-two on Thursday night is a normal January here. Cheap lights and standard tape fail when that humidity meets a freeze, which is why so many DIY strands are half dark by New Year's.

We use connectors and tape rated for wet winters, and we size the run wire to the actual length of the circuit, not the claim on the box. The C9 lines are cut to your roofline, so the light follows every ridge, peak and dormer with no gaps. Yard Dog Lights is our Christmas lights division, run by the same crew that works yards the rest of the year.
